title: Add window prefix to the order number
goal: Use map to convert each array element into the corresponding value, preserving the number and order of the input.
summary: The food pick-up window displays the number with a label starting with Q-. After getting a set of numbers, generate new labels in the same order.
tasks: complete labelTickets(numbers). Convert each number in the array into a Q- string plus the original number, for example, the number 12 corresponds to "Q-12".
returns a string array. Preserves order and duplicates, returns an empty array.

example.note: map calls the conversion function once for each item and collects the returned values ​​each time into the same array.

hint: When the arrow function callback uses curly braces, return must be written to hand the conversion result to the map. Omitting return makes each item undefined.
